observed_training_exposure.policy: Loss-computed sample exposure, including any trailing partial update; separate complete-update count is explicit.

evaluation_design.score: Arithmetic mean of four all-window group normalized MAEs

target_change.method: For each joint, peak-to-peak absolute ground-truth target within the 16-frame horizon divided by the maximum saved action normalization span over that horizon; take the maximum across nonconstant joints within each group and select scores > 0.05. This measures changing target commands, not state-action offset or semantic task phase.

coverage.policy: Only samples whose training loss was computed count. Prefetched shards and collator lookahead do not.

policy_scope: Offline action errors on fixed train and selection-validation windows only; successful robot box selection, grasping, lifting and carrying remain untested.

integrity_evidence.scope: Original protocol/load_completed CPU proofs cover all six report/prediction pairs; curation checked report/NPZ/summary/archive bindings and byte-identical small copies. Checkpoint weights were not re-read during curation.
